step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows HighResCam's serverless image processing pipeline using AWS Step Functions. High-resolution webcam images uploaded to S3 trigger a Step Functions workflow. Step Functions conditionally invokes parallel Lambda functions: an 'ANALYZE' stage using Amazon Rekognition and a custom ML framework for scene and object detection, and a 'PROCESS' stage for image transformation (rotation, blurring, and deep-zoom slicing into tiles) which saves updated image tiles back to S3. Extracted metadata is passed to a 'PERSIST' Lambda stage, which writes metadata into both RDS and DynamoDB databases and emits a completion event via Amazon SNS.

graph.name: HighResCam Image Processing Architecture
graph.categories: AI & Machine Learning, Media & Entertainment, Serverless
graph.notes: Handles processing high-resolution webcam images (20-40 Megapixels) uploaded to S3. Processed deep-zoom image tiles (up to 200 tiles per image) are stored back in S3 while metadata is saved in RDS and DynamoDB, followed by an SNS notification.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores uploaded high-resolution webcam images and resulting deep-zoom image tiles.

nodes.name: Step Functions
nodes.notes: Orchestrates the entire serverless processing workflow based on incoming camera configuration.

nodes.name: ANALYZE
nodes.notes: Parallel Lambda functions that run machine learning analysis on image data.

nodes.name: REKOGNITION
nodes.notes: AWS Rekognition used for scene recognition, weather detection, and mood/labeling.

nodes.name: ML
nodes.notes: Custom deep learning framework used for object detection on image data.

nodes.name: PROCESS
nodes.notes: Parallel Lambda functions for image transformation (rotation, blurring/pixelation) and deep-zoom tiling.

nodes.name: PERSIST
nodes.notes: Parallel Lambda functions responsible for persisting image metadata.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Relational database used to store image metadata.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: NoSQL database used to store image metadata.

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Publishes notifications upon completion of processing for a given image.

edges.notes: New S3 image upload triggers Step Functions workflow execution.
Step Functions invokes the ANALYZE Lambda stage if analysis is enabled in config.
Step Functions invokes the PROCESS Lambda stage directly or following the analysis step.
ANALYZE Lambda invokes AWS Rekognition for scene detection.
ANALYZE Lambda invokes deep learning ML framework for object detection.
PROCESS Lambda stores generated image tiles and modified images back into S3.
PROCESS Lambda passes metadata down to the PERSIST Lambda stage.
PERSIST Lambda writes extracted metadata into RDS.
PERSIST Lambda writes extracted metadata into DynamoDB.
PERSIST Lambda publishes notification to SNS signaling completion.
